about_the_game:
A digital soundtrack featuring all 22 tracks is also set for release!

The digital soundtrack "No Sleep For Kaname Date - From AI: THE SOMNIUM FILES", featuring all 22 tracks, will be available on Steam. With over 70 minutes of music, immerse yourself in the world of AI: The Somnium Files like never before.

Additionally, the album cover is an exclusive illustration by Yusuke Kozaki, featuring Iris in her new outfit.

*Track names are placeholders.
